description: Single storey infill extension at side/rear.
decision_conditions: The proposed ground floor rear infill extension, when taken together with the approved 6m deep rear extension under reference 25/03988/PRH, would result in a continuous and excessive rear projection of approximately 12m from the original dwelling. By reason of its cumulative depth, full-width infilling of the remaining gap, and consolidation of built form, the development would appear disproportionate to the narrow Victorian terrace, erode the distinction between the original dwelling and extensions, and create an overly dominant and elongated rear form that is out of keeping with the established pattern of development, contrary to Section 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2021), Policies D3 anD5 of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), and Policies DMD 11 and DMD 37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The proposed development, by virtue of its cumulative depth of approximately 12m, full-width infilling of the remaining gap, siting along the shared boundary, and resulting continuous built form, would give rise to an unneighbourly sense of enclosure and loss of outlook, and would reduce daylight to side-facing windows at the adjoining property, No. 43. The scale and proximity of the development would appear overbearing and materially harm the living conditions of neighbouring occupiers, contrary to Section 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2021), Policies D3 and D5, of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), and Policies DMD 8, DMD 11  and DMD 37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
